archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) blended with Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon)
emotional_tone: Futuristic, high-tech, precise, authoritative, and energetic.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing for marketing sections, dense 'Control Room' grid for dashboards and flow builders.

surfaces_and_materials.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 border-b border-[#27272A] z-50 sticky top-0
surfaces_and_materials.cards: bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#27272A] hover:border-[#F97316]/50 transition-colors duration-200

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly shift background or text color. Cards elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) or trigger border glow.

flow_builder.strategy: Use purely custom HTML/CSS/SVG for the canvas. Use absolute positioning for nodes. Draw SVG cubic bezier curves `<path d="M... C..." />` for edges connecting nodes. Do not use ReactFlow or third-party libraries.
flow_builder.node_anatomy: Header with icon and title, body with form inputs (Shadcn customized), handles (small circles) on left/right for inputs/outputs.

marketplace.strategy: Grid of MCP plugins. Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle neon borders on hover. Badges for LLM provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).

component_instructions.data_attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

icons.instruction: Default choice for SaaS. Use crisp outlines, set stroke-width to 1.5 or 2 based on density.

hero_background.description: Abstract black and orange squares/tech grid background. Use heavily overlaid with black to make it barely visible.

secondary_background.description: Wavy lines dark orange abstract. Good for login/register page background split.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind with strictly dark mode capabilities. Configure colors extending the primary orange and deep black neutral palette.
Implement the Layout with a fixed, dark sidebar for navigation and a top header that contains workspace switcher and user profile.

The Flow Builder must be built from scratch. Create a container with position:relative, mapping over an array of nodes rendering absolute div components. Use an SVG overlay spanning the entire container width/height to draw connecting lines between node coordinates.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default borders, radii (make them slightly sharper), and hover states to match the aggressive tech aesthetic.
Do NOT implement light mode toggles. Remove any theme switchers. Force dark mode context.
